tools.name: make_id_photo
tools.description: Turn a portrait photo into a compliant passport / visa / ID photo for a given document spec (cropping, resizing, background replacement, quality checks). Returns a temporary download URL for the finished JPEG, its pixel/physical size, and any detected quality issues (e.g. ISSUE_EYEGLASSES_NOT_ALLOWE

tools.name: list_photo_specs
tools.description: List all supported passport / visa / ID photo specifications as specCode + human-readable name (e.g. 'us-passport' = 'US Passport'). Use this to find the specCode for make_id_photo.

tools.name: get_photo_spec
tools.description: Get the detailed requirements of one photo spec: physical size, pixel size, DPI, background color, head height / eye position guidance, glasses and expression rules.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Show remaining quota. With API credentials: the idphoto.ai account status and remaining make-photo quota. Without credentials: how many free make_id_photo calls are left today.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "make_id_photo" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
